title: Understanding LASSO Regularization
text: LASSO regularization adds a penalty term to the loss function, which can shrink some coefficients to zero. This can lead to a simpler model.

title: Effect on Test MSE
text: Consider how reducing model complexity with LASSO might affect the model's performance on unseen data.

title: Analyzing Test MSE Changes
text: When LASSO regularization is applied, the model might become less complex. How could this affect the MSE on held-out test data?
